page.layout: One printed page with a title and two parallel columns of a table (Cap. | Vers. | Pag.), separated by a vertical rule; below the columns the closing line "FINIS LOCOR. S. SCRIPTURÆ" and the signature "QQQqqq"; a page number "113" in handwriting at top right (not transcribed).
page.notes: Two parallel columns of the index are transcribed in reading order, left column first. The left column's Cap. entries are as printed and some cap. numbers span several rows (e.g. the Michæas and Zacharias rows). The "QQQqqq" line is a signature mark at the foot and is given as printed. The handwritten "113" at top right is not printed text and is omitted from the transcription apart from the page number.
